vendor: Zendesk, Inc. (formerly Ultimate.ai Oy, Helsinki - acquired by Zendesk, March 2024)
product_family: Ultimate.ai was a standalone conversational-AI / customer-service-automation platform founded in Helsinki in 2016. Zendesk acquired it in March 2024 and fully absorbed it into the Zendesk Suite; it is no longer sold as an independent product. It now operates as 'AI Agents - Advanced (Ultimate)', the top automation tier of Zendesk's AI Agents line (sitting above 'AI Agents - Essential').

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Product-in-scope list for SOC 2: 'Ticketing, Help Center, Community Forums, Messaging and live chat, Reporting and Analytics, Messaging platform (Sunshine Conversations), Voice, AI Agents, Mobile Apps, Mobile Software Development Kits, Automations & intelligence.'

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: 'The scope of the ISO/IEC 27001:2013 ... certifications are bounded by Zendesk, Inc.'s global network infrastructure' covering management of Zendesk's core services; AI Agents is separately listed as SOC 2/ISO/HIPAA in-scope on the compliance-scope page.

certifications.name: ISO 27018:2019 (cloud PII)
certifications.proof_quote: 'The scope of the ... ISO/IEC 27018:2014 ... certifications are bounded by Zendesk, Inc.'s global network infrastructure.'

certifications.name: ISO 27701:2019 (privacy)
certifications.proof_quote: 'The scope of the ... ISO/IEC 27701:2019 ... certifications are bounded by Zendesk, Inc.'s global network infrastructure.'

certifications.name: ISO 42001:2023 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: 'The scope of the ... ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certifications are bounded by Zendesk, Inc.'s global network infrastructure.' Blog: 'Zendesk achieves ISO 42001 certification... scope includes Zendesk AI, Zendesk LMS, Zendesk QA, and Zendesk WFM.'

certifications.name: GDPR posture
certifications.proof_quote: Zendesk is described in its own privacy documentation as 'a third-party data processor under the GDPR' and offers 'features to support GDPR compliance, including native notice options seamlessly embedded into our tools,' plus a public Data Processing Agreement incorporating EU SCCs.

certifications.name: HIPAA (BAA available)
certifications.proof_quote: AI Agents is listed among the products in scope for the SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / HIPAA compliance table on Zendesk's own compliance-scope page; HIPAA support requires signing a BAA and the Advanced Data Privacy and Protection add-on.

certifications.name: FedRAMP LI-SaaS
certifications.proof_quote: FedRAMP Li-SaaS Tailored product list: 'Ticketing, Help Center, Community Forums, Reporting and Analytics, Voice, Messaging, Agent Workspace, AI Agents - Essential.' Only the Essential (lower) tier is in scope; 'AI Agents - Advanced (Ultimate)' is NOT listed as FedRAMP in-scope.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: 'PCI-DSS - For more information on automatically redacting credit card numbers or adding a credit card identification field' (corporate/platform-level cert; not confirmed as AI-Agents-specific in the product compliance-scope table).

certifications.name: CSA STAR AI Levels 1 & 2
certifications.proof_quote: 'CSA STAR AI Levels 1 & 2 certify advanced cloud security and AI governance practices, with Zendesk proudly being the first in the industry to achieve this recognition.'

certifications.name: Cyber Essentials Plus
certifications.proof_quote: UK government-backed certification 'that demonstrates an organization's commitment to strong cybersecurity through independent verification of key controls.'

privacy.ai_training_note: Zendesk's own AI Data Use documentation names the acquired product explicitly: for 'AI Agents - Advanced (Ultimate),' 'if Service Data is needed for training, customers directly determine how to sanitize the training dataset,' meaning training only happens on an opt-in, customer-controlled, account-scoped basis, not by default and not shared across customers. Generative AI features built on third-party LLMs are separately stated to not be trained on Zendesk customer data at all. Training for this tier is customer-instructed rather than categorically absent.
privacy.data_region: Customer-selectable data locality (US, EU/EEA, Australia, Japan) per Zendesk's Regional Data Hosting Policy; specific policy applying to the legacy Ultimate.ai workloads post-migration was not independently confirmed.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ (platform-wide Zendesk standard; not a distinct Ultimate.ai control)

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 in AWS; BYOK available via Advanced Data Privacy and Protection add-on

security.name: Hosting
security.value: Data hosted within Zendesk's SOC 2-certified AWS cloud environment

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: HackerOne-run responsible disclosure / bug bounty program (platform-wide)

products.name: AI Agents - Advanced (Ultimate)
products.category: Enterprise conversational AI / multi-step workflow automation for customer service
products.data_scope: Processes end-customer conversation Service Data across web, mobile, email, and voice; can be trained on account-scoped Service Data only if the customer opts in and controls sanitization.
products.notes: This is the direct successor product to the standalone Ultimate.ai platform; NOT covered by Zendesk's FedRAMP LI-SaaS authorization (only 'AI Agents - Essential' is).

products.name: AI Agents - Essential
products.data_scope: Lower-complexity automation bundled into standard Zendesk Suite plans.
products.notes: This tier, not the former Ultimate/Advanced tier, is the one covered by FedRAMP LI-SaaS.

compare.pricing_model: No longer sold standalone. Available only as a paid add-on/tier ('Advanced') within Zendesk Suite subscriptions; legacy independent Ultimate.ai pricing/contracts no longer apply.
compare.data_residency: Selectable within Zendesk's Regional Data Hosting Policy (US/EEA/AU/JP), inherited from parent platform.
top_certs: SOC 2 Type II (Zendesk platform, AI Agents in scope)

flags: 'Ultimate.ai' is not an independently operating vendor. ultimate.ai redirects to https://www.zendesk.com/service/ai/ai-agents.

All certifications listed here are Zendesk's corporate and platform certifications, not certifications independently earned by 'Ultimate.ai' as a company. They apply to the acquired product because Zendesk's own compliance-scope documentation explicitly lists 'AI Agents' (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) and, by name, 'AI Agents - Advanced (Ultimate)' (AI Data Use policy) as in-scope; this is inherited-via-acquisition coverage, not independent Ultimate.ai certification history.
FedRAMP LI-SaaS does not cover the Advanced/Ultimate tier; only 'AI Agents - Essential' is covered.
The Advanced/Ultimate tier permits customer-instructed, account-scoped training, which differs from the platform-wide claim that generative LLM features never train on customer data.
